summary: The University of Padua offers up to 76 Excellence Scholarships to international students on its English-taught degrees. Each waives student fees and adds €8,000 gross a year on the 2026/27 terms, and applying for the degree enters you automatically. Padua says the next notice comes in November 2026.
meta_title: Padua International Excellence Scholarship: fee waiver + €8,000
meta_description: Padua's Excellence Scholarship waives student fees and pays €8,000 gross a year. No separate form: apply to an English-taught degree by 15 November 2026.
covers: Exemption from student fees; you still pay the regional fee and the revenue stamp each year.
€8,000 gross a year, in two instalments of €4,000 gross, tied to the academic requirements in the notice.
Up to 2 years for a master's and up to 3 years for a bachelor's or single-cycle degree. These are the 2026/27 terms; Padua's 2027/28 notice is due in November 2026.
eligibility: You must not be an Italian citizen, unless you hold dual citizenship, and must not be resident in Italy when you apply.
You need a non-Italian secondary school diploma for a bachelor's or single-cycle degree, or a foreign degree for a master's.
You must apply to an English-taught bachelor's or master's within the deadline, enrol, and not hold another scholarship.
how_to_apply: Apply for an English-taught degree on apply.unipd.it. There is no separate scholarship form: your degree application enters you.

For programmes with unlimited places, the first call runs from 15 September to 15 November 2026. For limited-place programmes, the first call for non-EU citizens living abroad runs from 7 January to 7 March 2027.
Each programme's Teaching Committee selects recipients on academic excellence and past record.
watch_out: Awards are mainly reserved for the first call, so do not count on a later one.
Padua's next scholarship notice is due in November 2026, so check the amounts and number of awards when it appears.
The scholarship can be revoked if you earn fewer than 20 credits by 30 November of the following academic year, or if you transfer or withdraw.
Once the scholarship period ends, you pay tuition until you graduate.
costs: The scholarship waives them if you win it
Application fee of €60 (or the €55 CEnT-S test fee where required)
You, with the €8,000 gross a year towards them
documents: Your degree application on apply.unipd.it, with the documents that programme asks for.
The €60 application fee, or the €55 CEnT-S registration for programmes that require the test.

faq.q: Do I need a separate application for the Padua Excellence Scholarship?
faq.a: No. Applying to an eligible English-taught degree within the deadline also enters you for the scholarship.

Use the first call, since awards are mainly reserved for it: 15 September to 15 November 2026 for programmes with unlimited places, and 7 January to 7 March 2027 for limited-place programmes if you are a non-EU citizen living abroad.
